question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She writes a letter.
options: A letter was written by her.
A letter is written by her.
A letter is being written by her.
A letter will be written by her.
answer: A letter is written by her.
explanation: यह वाक्य Present Indefinite में है। Active (V1/V5) को Passive में बदलते समय (is/am/are + V3) का प्रयोग होता है। 'A letter' नया Subject बनता है।
trick: Present Simple में हमेशा 'is/am/are + V3' खोजें, 'was' या 'being' वाले विकल्पों को तुरंत काट दें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: He does not play cricket.
options: Cricket is not played by him.
Cricket does not played by him.
Cricket was not played by him.
Cricket has not been played by him.
answer: Cricket is not played by him.
explanation: Present Indefinite (Negative) में 'do/does not + V1' को 'is/am/are + not + V3' में बदला जाता है। 'Cricket' एकवचन है इसलिए 'is' लगेगा।
trick: Passive voice में 'do/does' का प्रयोग कभी नहीं होता, सीधे 'is/am/are' देखें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Do they speak English?
options: Is English spoken by them?
Are English spoken by them?
Does English spoken by them?
Was English spoken by them?
answer: Is English spoken by them?
explanation: Interrogative वाक्य में सहायक क्रिया पहले आती है। 'English' (Singular Subject) के अनुसार 'Is' वाक्य के शुरू में लगेगा।
trick: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य Passive में भी प्रश्नवाचक ही रहता है, शुरुआत 'Is/Am/Are' से करें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I am eating an apple.
options: An apple is eaten by me.
An apple was being eaten by me.
An apple is being eaten by me.
An apple has been eaten by me.
answer: An apple is being eaten by me.
explanation: Present Continuous Tense में 'is/am/are + V1+ing' को 'is/am/are + being + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: Continuous tense में 'being' का होना अनिवार्य है, बिना 'being' वाले विकल्प गलत हैं।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They are not reading books.
options: Books are not being read by them.
Books is not being read by them.
Books were not being read by them.
Books are not read by them.
answer: Books are not being read by them.
explanation: 'Books' बहुवचन है इसलिए 'are' का प्रयोग होगा। Negative Continuous में 'are not being + V3' लगता है।
trick: Subject 'Books' (Plural) है, इसलिए 'is' वाले विकल्प तुरंत हटा दें।
tip: Plural Object -> are + not + being + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Is she singing a song?
options: Is a song sung by her?
Was a song being sung by her?
Is a song being sung by her?
Has a song been sung by her?
answer: Is a song being sung by her?
explanation: प्रश्नवाचक Present Continuous वाक्य। 'Is + Subject + being + V3' का ढांचा प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'a song' एकवचन है।
trick: Continuous Interrogative में 'Is/Are + Subject + being' खोजें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: He has completed the work.
options: The work have been completed by him.
The work has been completed by him.
The work was completed by him.
The work is completed by him.
answer: The work has been completed by him.
explanation: Present Perfect Tense में 'has/have + V3' को 'has/have + been + V3' में बदला जाता है। 'The work' Singular है इसलिए 'has' लगेगा।
trick: Perfect Tense में हमेशा 'been' खोजें, बिना 'been' के Passive नहीं बनता।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: We have not bought a car.
options: A car has not been bought by us.
A car have not been bought by us.
A car was not bought by us.
A car is not being bought by us.
answer: A car has not been bought by us.
explanation: 'A car' एकवचन है, इसलिए Active के 'have' के बजाय Passive में 'has not been' का प्रयोग होगा।
trick: Active में 'We' के साथ 'have' था, लेकिन Passive में 'A car' के साथ 'has' लगेगा। Subject-Verb Agreement का ध्यान रखें।
tip: Singular Object -> has not been + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Have you seen the Taj Mahal?
options: Has the Taj Mahal been seen by you?
Have the Taj Mahal been seen by you?
Was the Taj Mahal seen by you?
Is the Taj Mahal seen by you?
answer: Has the Taj Mahal been seen by you?
explanation: Interrogative Perfect Tense. 'The Taj Mahal' एकवचन है, इसलिए वाक्य 'Has' से शुरू होगा, 'Have' से नहीं।
trick: प्रश्न की शुरुआत Object के Number (Singular/Plural) के अनुसार करें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I wrote a poem.
options: A poem is written by me.
A poem was written by me.
A poem had been written by me.
A poem was being written by me.
answer: A poem was written by me.
explanation: Past Indefinite (V2) को Passive में 'was/were + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: V2 देखते ही सीधे 'was/were + V3' वाले विकल्प पर जाएँ।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She did not help me.
options: I am not helped by her.
I was not helped by her.
I had not been helped by her.
I did not helped by her.
answer: I was not helped by her.
explanation: Past Indefinite Negative 'did not + V1' को 'was/were + not + V3' में बदला जाता है। 'me' का Subjective form 'I' होगा।
trick: Passive में 'did' का प्रयोग कभी नहीं होता। 'I' के साथ 'was' आता है।
tip: did not + V1 -> was/were not + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Did you call him?
options: Was he called by you?
Is he called by you?
Did he called by you?
Had he been called by you?
answer: Was he called by you?
explanation: Past Indefinite Interrogative. 'him' का Subject 'he' बनेगा जिसके साथ 'Was' का प्रयोग वाक्य के प्रारंभ में होगा।
trick: 'Did' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्यों का Passive हमेशा 'Was/Were' से शुरू होता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They were watching TV.
options: TV is being watched by them.
TV was being watched by them.
TV had been watched by them.
TV was watched by them.
answer: TV was being watched by them.
explanation: Past Continuous 'was/were + V-ing' को 'was/were + being + V3' में बदलते हैं।
trick: Continuous Tense (चाहे Present हो या Past) में 'being' ढूँढना सबसे तेज तरीका है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: He was not driving the car.
options: The car was not being driven by him.
The car is not being driven by him.
The car had not been driven by him.
The car was not driven by him.
answer: The car was not being driven by him.
explanation: Past Continuous Negative. Object 'the car' के साथ 'was not being + V3 (driven)' का प्रयोग होगा।
trick: Negative Continuous में 'not' हमेशा 'being' से पहले आता है (not being)।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Were you making a noise?
options: Was a noise being made by you?
Were a noise being made by you?
Is a noise being made by you?
Had a noise been made by you?
answer: Was a noise being made by you?
explanation: 'a noise' Singular है, इसलिए Active में 'Were' होने के बावजूद Passive की शुरुआत 'Was' से होगी।
trick: हमेशा नए Subject ('a noise') के अनुसार Helping Verb (Was) चुनें, पुराने Subject ('you') के अनुसार नहीं।
tip: Match Was/Were with the new Subject.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She had cooked food.
options: Food has been cooked by her.
Food was cooked by her.
Food had been cooked by her.
Food is cooked by her.
answer: Food had been cooked by her.
explanation: Past Perfect 'had + V3' को 'had + been + V3' में बदला जाता है। इसमें Singular/Plural का कोई झंझट नहीं होता।
trick: 'had' वाले वाक्यों में सिर्फ 'been' जोड़ना होता है, बाकी सब समान रहता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: We had not played chess.
options: Chess had not been played by us.
Chess has not been played by us.
Chess was not played by us.
Chess did not played by us.
answer: Chess had not been played by us.
explanation: Past Perfect Negative. 'had not' को 'had not been' में बदलें। 'us' Object बन जाएगा।
trick: Tense न बदलें; Past Perfect हमेशा Past Perfect (had been) में ही रहेगा।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Had he won the match?
options: Has the match been won by him?
Had the match been won by him?
Was the match won by him?
Had the match won by him?
answer: Had the match been won by him?
explanation: Interrogative Past Perfect. 'Had' अपनी जगह पर रहेगा, Subject 'the match' के बाद 'been' लगेगा।
trick: Past Perfect Interrogative में 'Had + Object + been + V3' का क्रम याद रखें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I will help you.
options: You will be helped by me.
You would be helped by me.
You will helped by me.
You are helped by me.
answer: You will be helped by me.
explanation: Future Indefinite 'will/shall + V1' को 'will/shall + be + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: Future Indefinite में 'be' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है। 'would' (Narration) में न बदलें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She will not tell a lie.
options: A lie will not be told by her.
A lie would not be told by her.
A lie will not told by her.
A lie is not told by her.
answer: A lie will not be told by her.
explanation: Future Indefinite Negative. 'will not + V1' बदलकर 'will not be + V3' हो जाता है।
trick: 'not' का स्थान 'will' और 'be' के बीच में होता है (will not be)।
tip: will not -> will not be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Will you open the door?
options: Will the door be opened by you?
Would the door be opened by you?
Is the door opened by you?
Will the door opened by you?
answer: Will the door be opened by you?
explanation: Interrogative Future Indefinite. 'Will + Subject + be + V3' का प्रयोग होगा।
trick: प्रश्नवाचक में 'be' हमेशा Subject ('the door') के बाद आता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They will have finished the project.
options: The project would have been finished by them.
The project will have been finished by them.
The project will be finished by them.
The project has been finished by them.
answer: The project will have been finished by them.
explanation: Future Perfect 'will have + V3' को 'will have been + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: Future Perfect में 'have been' खोजना सबसे आसान शॉर्टकट है।
tip: will have + V3 -> will have been + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: He will not have received the letter.
options: The letter will not have been received by him.
The letter would not have been received by him.
The letter will not be received by him.
The letter has not been received by him.
answer: The letter will not have been received by him.
explanation: Future Perfect Negative में 'will not have been + V3' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
trick: Negative Future Perfect में 'not' हमेशा 'will' और 'have' के बीच में आता है।
tip: will not have -> will not have been

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Will she have cooked the dinner?
options: Will the dinner have been cooked by her?
Would the dinner have been cooked by her?
Will the dinner be cooked by her?
Has the dinner been cooked by her?
answer: Will the dinner have been cooked by her?
explanation: Interrogative Future Perfect. 'Will + Subject + have been + V3' का स्ट्रक्चर फॉलो होता है।
trick: 'have been' हमेशा नए Subject (the dinner) के बाद ही आएगा।
tip: Will... have V3 -> Will... have been V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I can lift this box.
options: This box can be lifted by me.
This box could be lifted by me.
This box is lifted by me.
This box can lifted by me.
answer: This box can be lifted by me.
explanation: Modals (can, could, may, might आदि) वाले वाक्यों में Passive बनाते समय Modal के साथ 'be' जोड़कर V3 लगाते हैं।
trick: Voice में Modal कभी नहीं बदलता (Can का Could नहीं होता, वह Narration में होता है)।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She cannot solve this puzzle.
options: This puzzle could not be solved by her.
This puzzle cannot be solved by her.
This puzzle cannot solved by her.
This puzzle is not solved by her.
answer: This puzzle cannot be solved by her.
explanation: Negative Modal में 'cannot + V1' को 'cannot be + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: सिर्फ 'be' जोड़ें और क्रिया को 3rd form (solved) में बदल दें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Could you bring some water?
options: Could some water be brought by you?
Can some water be brought by you?
Was some water brought by you?
Could some water brought by you?
answer: Could some water be brought by you?
explanation: Interrogative Modal. Modal अपनी जगह (शुरुआत) पर रहता है, Subject के बाद 'be + V3' आता है।
trick: 'Could' को 'Can' में न बदलें। Voice में Tense/Modal का रूप अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
tip: Modal + Sub + V1 -> Modal + Sub + be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: You must obey your parents.
options: Your parents must obeyed by you.
Your parents must be obeyed by you.
Your parents should be obeyed by you.
Your parents are obeyed by you.
answer: Your parents must be obeyed by you.
explanation: 'must + V1' को 'must be + V3' में बदल दिया जाता है। 'your parents' Object से Subject बन जाता है।
trick: 'must' को 'should' में न बदलें, जो Modal दिया है उसी में 'be' लगाएँ।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: We should respect our elders.
options: Our elders should be respected by us.
Our elders must be respected by us.
Our elders are respected by us.
Our elders should respected by us.
answer: Our elders should be respected by us.
explanation: 'should + V1' बदलकर 'should be + V3' हो जाता है। 'by us' लगाना वैकल्पिक हो सकता है, पर दिए गए विकल्पों में सबसे सटीक यही है।
trick: नैतिक कर्तव्य वाले वाक्यों में Modal (should) के साथ 'be + V3' का ही नियम लागू होता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: May I use your pen?
options: Might your pen be used by me?
Can your pen be used by me?
May your pen be used by me?
Is your pen used by me?
answer: May your pen be used by me?
explanation: Modal Interrogative में वाक्य Modal से ही शुरू होता है। 'May + Object (your pen) + be + V3 (used)' सही क्रम है।
trick: अनुमति माँगने वाले 'May' को 'Might' या 'Can' में न बदलें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They might win the game.
options: The game might be won by them.
The game may be won by them.
The game might won by them.
The game could be won by them.
answer: The game might be won by them.
explanation: 'might + V1' को 'might be + V3' (won) में बदला जाता है।
trick: 'might' को 'may' में बदलकर कन्फ्यूज न हों।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: You ought to help the poor.
options: The poor ought to be helped by you.
The poor should be helped by you.
The poor ought be helped by you.
The poor must be helped by you.
answer: The poor ought to be helped by you.
explanation: 'ought to + V1' को 'ought to be + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: 'ought' के बाद 'to be' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है, सिर्फ 'ought be' गलत है।
tip: ought to -> ought to be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Open the window.
options: Let the window be opened.
The window should be opened.
You are ordered to open the window.
All of the above are correct in different contexts, but pick the standard 'Let' form.
answer: Let the window be opened.
explanation: Imperative वाक्यों (आदेश) को Passive में बदलने के लिए 'Let + Object + be + V3' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
trick: अगर Object (the window) दिया है, तो 'Let' वाला तरीका सबसे उपयुक्त माना जाता है।
tip: V1 + Object -> Let + Object + be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Please give me a book.
options: Let a book be given to me.
You are requested to give me a book.
A book is requested to be given.
You are ordered to give me a book.
answer: You are requested to give me a book.
explanation: Imperative वाक्यों में जहाँ 'Please' या 'Kindly' लगा हो, वहाँ 'You are requested to + V1' का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: 'Please' देखते ही 'You are requested to' वाला विकल्प चुनें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Do not insult the weak.
options: Let the weak not be insulted.
The weak should not be insulted.
Both A and B can be correct, select Let form.
Let not the weak insulted.
answer: Let the weak not be insulted.
explanation: Negative Imperative को 'Let + Object + not + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है। 'The weak should not be insulted' भी सही है, लेकिन 'Let' फॉर्म प्राथमिक है।
trick: 'not' का प्रयोग 'be' से ठीक पहले करें (not be insulted)।
tip: Do not -> Let + Obj + not be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Let him do this work.
options: Let this work be done by him.
This work should be done by him.
Let this work done by him.
Let he do this work.
answer: Let this work be done by him.
explanation: 'Let' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्यों का Passive 'Let + Direct Object (this work) + be + V3 + by + Indirect Object (him)' होता है।
trick: पहले से 'Let' वाले वाक्यों में भी Passive 'Let' से ही शुरू होता है।
tip: Let + Obj1 + V1 + Obj2 -> Let + Obj2 + be + V3 + by + Obj1

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: He gave me a pen.
options: A pen was given to me by him.
I was given a pen by him.
Both A and B are correct.
Me was given a pen by him.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: इस वाक्य में दो Objects हैं: 'me' (Indirect) और 'a pen' (Direct)। दोनों से Passive बन सकता है: 'I was given a pen...' या 'A pen was given to me...'।
trick: जब Direct Object (निर्जीव) को Subject बनाते हैं, तो Indirect Object (सजीव) के पहले 'to' लगाना अनिवार्य होता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She teaches us English.
options: We are taught English by her.
English is taught to us by her.
Both A and B.
English was taught to us by her.
answer: Both A and B.
explanation: Present Indefinite में Double Object. 'We' से शुरू करने पर 'We are taught English...' और 'English' से शुरू करने पर 'English is taught to us...' बनेगा।
trick: Tense (is/are) पर ध्यान दें। 'was' वाला विकल्प तुरंत गलत कर दें।
tip: Check Tense carefully in Double Object.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They elected him president.
options: He was elected president by them.
President was elected him by them.
He is elected president by them.
He had been elected president by them.
answer: He was elected president by them.
explanation: यहाँ 'president' Objective Complement है, Object नहीं। इसलिए Subject केवल 'him' (He) बनेगा।
trick: Complement (पद/उपाधि) को कभी भी Passive का Subject न बनाएँ।
tip: Make the real object the subject, not the complement.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I know him.
options: He is known by me.
He is known to me.
He was known to me.
He is know to me.
answer: He is known to me.
explanation: 'Know' और 'Oblige' क्रियाओं के साथ Passive में 'by' के स्थान पर 'to' Preposition का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: परीक्षा में 'known by' वाला विकल्प हमेशा ट्रैप होता है, इससे बचें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The news surprised me.
options: I was surprised by the news.
I was surprised at the news.
I am surprised at the news.
I was surprised with the news.
answer: I was surprised at the news.
explanation: 'Surprise', 'astonish', 'shock' आदि क्रियाओं के साथ Passive में 'at' Preposition लगता है, 'by' नहीं।
trick: वाक्य Past Indefinite में है इसलिए 'was' लगेगा। Preposition 'at' पर फोकस करें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Smoke filled the room.
options: The room was filled by smoke.
The room was filled with smoke.
The room is filled with smoke.
The room had been filled with smoke.
answer: The room was filled with smoke.
explanation: 'Fill' क्रिया के साथ Passive voice में 'with' Preposition का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
trick: 'filled by' एक बहुत ही सामान्य गलती है जो छात्र करते हैं।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: This jug contains milk.
options: Milk is contained by this jug.
Milk was contained in this jug.
Milk is contained in this jug.
Milk is contain in this jug.
answer: Milk is contained in this jug.
explanation: 'Contain' और 'embody' क्रियाओं के साथ Passive voice में 'in' Preposition का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: Present Tense 'contains' है, इसलिए 'is' लगेगा और 'by' की जगह 'in' आएगा।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Someone has stolen my purse.

answer: My purse has been stolen.
explanation: जब Active का Subject स्पष्ट न हो (someone, somebody, people, nobody), तो Passive में 'by + Agent' को छोड़ देना बेहतर माना जाता है।
trick: विकल्पों में 'by someone' वाले विकल्प से बचें यदि बिना 'by someone' वाला विकल्प मौजूद हो।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: People speak English all over the world.

English is spoken all over the world.

English is being spoken all over the world.
answer: English is spoken all over the world.
explanation: 'People' एक Vague Subject है। Passive में 'by people' को हटा दिया जाता है क्योंकि यह सर्वविदित (understood) है।
trick: वाक्य के अर्थ को समझें, जहाँ कर्ता महत्वपूर्ण नहीं है, उसे हटा दें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: It is time to take tea.
options: It is time for tea to be taken.
It is time that tea should be taken.
It is time tea to be taken.
It is time for tea taken.
answer: It is time for tea to be taken.
explanation: 'It is time + to + V1 + Object' संरचना का Passive 'It is time + for + Object + to be + V3' होता है।
trick: 'It is time' के तुरंत बाद 'for' का प्रयोग करना न भूलें।
tip: to + V1 -> for + Obj + to be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: There is no time to lose.
options: There is no time to be lost.
There is no time for lost.
There was no time to be lost.
No time is there to lose.
answer: There is no time to be lost.
explanation: 'There + verb + noun + infinitive' वाले वाक्यों में केवल Infinitive (to lose) को Passive (to be lost) में बदला जाता है।
trick: शुरुआती हिस्से 'There is no time' में कोई बदलाव नहीं करना है।
tip: to + V1 -> to be + V3 (in There... structure)

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Women like men to flatter them.
options: Women like to be flattered by men.
Women are liked by men to flatter.

Men are liked by women to be flattered.
answer: Women like to be flattered by men.
explanation: Subject + verb + object + infinitive संरचना में, यदि Active का Object और Infinitive का Object समान हो, तो 'to be + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: Women खुद flatter होना पसंद करती हैं, इसलिए 'Women like to be flattered' सही अर्थ देता है।
tip: Focus on who is receiving the action.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I remember my father taking me to the zoo.
options: I remember being taken to the zoo by my father.

answer: I remember being taken to the zoo by my father.

trick: taking (Gerund) को being taken में बदलें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Who wrote this book?
options: By whom was this book written?
Who was this book written by?

answer: Both A and B.
explanation: 'Who' को 'By whom' में बदलकर वाक्य शुरू कर सकते हैं, या 'Who' से वाक्य शुरू करके अंत में 'by' लगा सकते हैं। दोनों सही हैं।
trick: आधुनिक अंग्रेजी में 'Who ... by' भी व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः मान्य है। 'By who' हमेशा गलत होता है।
tip: Who -> By whom OR Who... by

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The manager approves the budget.

answer: The budget is approved by the manager.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'the budget' को नया Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: वाक्य Present Indefinite (approves) में है, इसलिए 'is/am/are + V3' का प्रयोग होगा। 'the budget' एकवचन है अतः 'is approved' सही है।
trick: Present Simple में 'is/are + V3' देखें। 'was' या 'being' वाले विकल्पों को तुरंत हटा दें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The company does not accept checks.

answer: Checks are not accepted by the company.

trick: Passive Voice में do/does का प्रयोग कभी नहीं होता। बहुवचन Subject के साथ 'are' लगाएँ।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Do the students understand the concept?

answer: Is the concept understood by the students?
explanation: चरण 1: Interrogative वाक्य में नया Subject 'the concept' (एकवचन) है। चरण 2: इसलिए वाक्य की शुरुआत 'Is' से होगी। 'understand' का V3 'understood' होगा।
trick: नए Subject के अनुसार Helping Verb चुनें। 'the concept' Singular है, अतः 'Is' आएगा।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Why do people admire him?

answer: Why is he admired by people?

trick: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में Helping verb (is) हमेशा Subject (he) से पहले आती है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The chef is preparing a special dish.

trick: Continuous tense (V-ing) देखते ही विकल्पों में 'being' खोजना शुरू करें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The mechanic is not fixing the car.

trick: हमेशा 'not' को 'being' से पहले रखें (not being)।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Are the workers building a new bridge?

answer: Is a new bridge being built by the workers?

trick: पुराने Subject (workers) के 'Are' पर ध्यान न दें, नए Subject (bridge) के अनुसार 'Is' चुनें।
tip: Match Is/Are with the new Subject.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: What are you watching on TV?

trick: 'What' वाले वाक्यों में Subject छिपे होने के कारण 'is being + V3' सीधा प्रयोग होता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The committee has announced the results.

trick: Perfect Tense में 'been' अनिवार्य है। Singular/Plural का ध्यान रखें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: She has not invited them to the party.

trick: Active में 'She' के साथ 'has' था, लेकिन Passive में 'They' के साथ 'have' लगेगा।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The guard did not open the gate.

trick: Wh-word के तुरंत बाद 'was/were' का प्रयोग करें, उसके बाद नया Subject लिखें।

trick: Continuous Tense में 'being' अनिवार्य है। बहुवचन Subject के साथ 'were' चुनें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The team had won the championship before 2020.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The author had not published the book.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Had the police caught the thief?

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The government will build a new hospital.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The principal will not declare a holiday.

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Will the courier deliver the package today?

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: When will the manager hold the meeting?

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The scientists will have discovered a cure by 2050.

trick: Future Perfect में 'have been' खोजना सबसे आसान শর্টकट है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They will not have completed the bridge by next month.

The bridge will not be completed by them by next month.
The bridge will have not been completed by them by next month.
answer: The bridge will not have been completed by them by next month.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'The bridge' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Negative में 'will not have been + V3' का क्रम इस्तेमाल करें।
trick: 'not' हमेशा पहली सहायक क्रिया (will) के तुरंत बाद आता है (will not have been)।
tip: will not have -> will not have been

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Will she have cooked dinner before we arrive?
options: Will dinner have been cooked by her before we arrive?
Would dinner have been cooked by her before we arrive?
Will dinner be cooked by her before we arrive?
Has dinner been cooked by her before we arrive?
answer: Will dinner have been cooked by her before we arrive?
explanation: चरण 1: 'Will' से वाक्य शुरू करें। चरण 2: Subject 'dinner' के बाद 'have been cooked' लगाएँ। शेष क्लॉज (before we arrive) समान रहेगा।
trick: Subject के बाद 'have been' का प्रयोग सुनिश्चित करें, 'has been' का नहीं (Modal के बाद have आता है)।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: How will he have solved this complex puzzle?
options: How will this complex puzzle have been solved by him?
How this complex puzzle will have been solved by him?
How would this complex puzzle have been solved by him?
How will this complex puzzle be solved by him?
answer: How will this complex puzzle have been solved by him?
explanation: चरण 1: 'How will' के बाद नया Subject 'this complex puzzle' रखें। चरण 2: उसके बाद 'have been + V3 (solved)' जोड़ें।
trick: स्ट्रक्चर याद रखें: Wh-word + will + Subject + have been + V3।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The students can solve this equation easily.
options: This equation could be solved by the students easily.
This equation can be solved by the students easily.
This equation is solved by the students easily.
This equation can solved by the students easily.
answer: This equation can be solved by the students easily.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'This equation' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: Modals (can) के साथ Passive बनाते समय 'can be + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: 'Can' को 'Could' में न बदलें। Voice में Modal का रूप अपरिवर्तित रहता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The pilot could not land the plane safely.
options: The plane could not be landed by the pilot safely.
The plane cannot be landed by the pilot safely.
The plane was not landed by the pilot safely.
The plane could not landed by the pilot safely.
answer: The plane could not be landed by the pilot safely.
explanation: चरण 1: 'the plane' Subject बनेगा। चरण 2: Negative Modal 'could not' के साथ 'be + V3' (landed) लगेगा।
trick: सिर्फ 'be' जोड़ें और क्रिया को 3rd form में बदल दें (could not be)।
tip: could not -> could not be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: May I take your pen?
options: Might your pen be taken by me?
Can your pen be taken by me?
May your pen be taken by me?
Is your pen taken by me?
answer: May your pen be taken by me?
explanation: चरण 1: Modal Interrogative में 'May' शुरू में ही रहेगा। चरण 2: Subject 'your pen' के बाद 'be + V3' (taken) आएगा।
trick: अनुमति माँगने वाले 'May' को 'Might' या 'Can' में न बदलें।
tip: May + Sub + V1 -> May + Sub + be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: They might cancel the flight due to bad weather.
options: The flight may be cancelled by them due to bad weather.
The flight might be cancelled by them due to bad weather.
The flight might cancel by them due to bad weather.
The flight could be cancelled by them due to bad weather.
answer: The flight might be cancelled by them due to bad weather.
explanation: चरण 1: 'the flight' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: 'might + V1' को 'might be + V3' (cancelled) में बदलें।
trick: 'might' को 'may' या 'could' में बदलकर कन्फ्यूज न हों।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: You must follow the traffic rules.
options: The traffic rules should be followed by you.
The traffic rules must be followed by you.
The traffic rules must followed by you.
The traffic rules are followed by you.
answer: The traffic rules must be followed by you.
explanation: चरण 1: Object 'the traffic rules' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: 'must + V1' को 'must be + V3' में बदल दें।
trick: 'must' को 'should' में न बदलें, जो Modal दिया है उसी में 'be' लगाएँ।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The citizens should elect honest leaders.
options: Honest leaders must be elected by the citizens.
Honest leaders should be elected by the citizens.
Honest leaders are elected by the citizens.
Honest leaders should elected by the citizens.
answer: Honest leaders should be elected by the citizens.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Honest leaders' को Subject बनाएँ। चरण 2: 'should + V1' बदलकर 'should be + V3' हो जाता है।
trick: कर्तव्य वाले वाक्यों में Modal (should) के साथ 'be + V3' का ही नियम लागू होता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: We ought to respect our national flag.
options: Our national flag ought to be respected by us.
Our national flag should be respected by us.
Our national flag must be respected by us.
Our national flag ought be respected by us.
answer: Our national flag ought to be respected by us.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Our national flag' Subject बनेगा। चरण 2: 'ought to + V1' को 'ought to be + V3' में बदला जाता है।
trick: 'ought' के बाद 'to be' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है, सिर्फ 'ought be' गलत है।
tip: ought to -> ought to be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Shut the door immediately.
options: Let the door be shut immediately.
The door should be shut immediately.
You are ordered to shut the door immediately.
Both A and C are acceptable, but choose the standard Let form.
answer: Let the door be shut immediately.
explanation: चरण 1: Imperative (आदेश) वाक्यों में 'Let + Object + be + V3' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: 'shut' की तीनों forms समान होती हैं।
trick: अगर Object (the door) स्पष्ट रूप से दिया है, तो 'Let' वाला तरीका प्राथमिक माना जाता है।
tip: V1 + Obj -> Let + Obj + be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Please bring me a glass of water.
options: Let a glass of water be brought to me.
You are requested to bring me a glass of water.
A glass of water is requested to be brought.
You are ordered to bring me a glass of water.
answer: You are requested to bring me a glass of water.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Please' या 'Kindly' से शुरू होने वाले वाक्यों में निवेदन (Request) होता है। चरण 2: ऐसे वाक्यों को 'You are requested to + V1' से बनाते हैं।
trick: 'Please' देखते ही 'You are requested to' वाला विकल्प चुनें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Never tell a lie.
options: Let a lie never be told.
A lie should never be told.
Both A and B are correct.
You are requested never to tell a lie.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: यह नैतिक सलाह (Advice) है। इसे 'Let + Object + never be + V3' या 'Object + should never be + V3' दोनों तरीकों से बनाया जा सकता है।
trick: सलाह वाले वाक्यों में 'should be' का प्रयोग ज्यादा प्रचलित है, लेकिन 'Let' का ढांचा भी व्याकरणीय रूप से सही है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: I have to finish this work today.
options: This work has to be finished by me today.
This work have to be finished by me today.
This work is finished by me today.
This work had to be finished by me today.
answer: This work has to be finished by me today.
explanation: चरण 1: Infinitive 'to + V1' को Passive में 'to be + V3' में बदलते हैं। चरण 2: नए Subject 'This work' के अनुसार 'have' को 'has' में बदलें (has to be finished)।
trick: 'to + V1' हमेशा 'to be + V3' में बदलता है। Subject-Verb agreement का ध्यान रखें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: My father gifted me a watch.
options: A watch was gifted to me by my father.
I was gifted a watch by my father.
Both A and B are correct.
Me was gifted a watch by my father.
answer: Both A and B are correct.
explanation: चरण 1: वाक्य में दो Objects हैं (me और a watch)। चरण 2: सजीव (I) या निर्जीव (A watch) किसी को भी Subject बनाकर Passive बनाया जा सकता है।
trick: जब निर्जीव वस्तु (a watch) Subject बने, तो सजीव Object (me) से पहले 'to' लगाना अनिवार्य है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: The boys laughed at the beggar.
options: The beggar was laughed by the boys.
The beggar was laughed at by the boys.
The beggar is laughed at by the boys.
The beggar was being laughed at by the boys.
answer: The beggar was laughed at by the boys.
explanation: चरण 1: 'the beggar' को Subject बनाएँ और 'was laughed' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: Verb के साथ जुड़े Preposition 'at' को न हटाएं, वह V3 के साथ ही रहेगा।
trick: Phrasal verbs (laugh at, look after) में Preposition कभी नहीं हटता है, वह 'by' से पहले लगता है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Her performance satisfied the judges.
options: The judges were satisfied by her performance.
The judges were satisfied with her performance.
The judges are satisfied with her performance.
The judges were satisfied at her performance.
answer: The judges were satisfied with her performance.
explanation: चरण 1: 'the judges' को Subject बनाकर 'were satisfied' लगाएँ। चरण 2: 'Satisfied', 'pleased', 'disgusted' क्रियाओं के साथ Passive में 'by' नहीं, बल्कि 'with' लगता है।
trick: 'satisfied by' हमेशा गलत विकल्प होता है, सही Preposition 'with' है।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Someone has stolen my bicycle.
options: My bicycle has been stolen by someone.
My bicycle has been stolen.
My bicycle had been stolen.
My bicycle is stolen.
answer: My bicycle has been stolen.
explanation: चरण 1: 'My bicycle' को Subject बनाएँ और 'has been stolen' लगाएँ। चरण 2: Vague Subject (Someone, people, nobody) को Passive में 'by' के साथ लिखने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती।
trick: यदि विकल्पों में 'by someone' वाला और बिना 'by someone' वाला दोनों हों, तो हमेशा बिना 'by someone' वाला विकल्प चुनें।

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: It is time to ring the bell.
options: It is time the bell to be rung.
It is time for the bell to be rung.
It is time that the bell should be rung.
It is time for the bell to ring.
answer: It is time for the bell to be rung.
explanation: चरण 1: 'It is time' वाले वाक्यों में 'for + Object' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: Infinitive 'to ring' को 'to be rung' में बदल दिया जाता है।
trick: 'It is time' के तुरंत बाद 'for' खोजना इस स्ट्रक्चर को हल करने का सबसे आसान तरीका है।
tip: It is time for + Obj + to be + V3

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Who broke this beautiful vase?
options: By whom was this beautiful vase broken?
Who was this beautiful vase broken by?
Both A and B.
By who was this beautiful vase broken?
answer: Both A and B.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Who' को या तो शुरू में 'By whom' में बदलें, या 'Who' को शुरू में रखकर वाक्य के अंत में 'by' लगाएँ। चरण 2: दोनों ही तरीके आधुनिक ग्रामर में पूर्णतः मान्य हैं।
trick: 'By who' हमेशा गलत होता है। 'Who... by' या 'By whom' सही संरचनाएं हैं।
tip: Who -> By whom OR Who... by

question: Choose the correct passive voice form: Whom did you recommend for the job?
options: Who was recommended for the job by you?
Whom was recommended for the job by you?
By whom was recommended for the job by you?
Who did recommended for the job by you?
answer: Who was recommended for the job by you?
explanation: चरण 1: 'Whom' (Object) को Passive में Subject 'Who' बनाया जाता है। चरण 2: Past Indefinite के कारण 'Who' के साथ 'was' और V3 (recommended) का प्रयोग होता है।
trick: Active में जो 'Whom' होता है, वह Passive में 'Who' बन जाता है। (और Who, By whom बन जाता है)।
